conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer David Reed, badge number 671102. With whom am I speaking?
Uh, hi, this is Samantha Ellis. I got a call saying there was a problem with my taxes?
Yes, Ms. Ellis. I am calling regarding a tax discrepancy linked to your social security number. Before we proceed, can you verify your full date of birth for the case file?
It's July 19, 1999.
Thank you. For security, I also need the last four digits of your SSN.
Um, it's 4587. Can you tell me what this is about?
According to IRS records, you failed to report income on your 2022 tax return. This has triggered an audit and a federal case of tax evasion against you.
What? I thought I filed everything correctly. This is my first job after college.

Ms. Ellis, this is a very serious matter. There is already a warrant issued for your arrest due to unpaid back taxes and suspected fraud. If this is not resolved immediately, law enforcement will be dispatched to your address.
Wait, what? Arrest? I'm just trying to do everything right. How much do I supposedly owe?
The total outstanding balance is $3,782.76 including penalties and legal fees. You must settle this amount right now to stop the arrest warrant from being executed.
I don't have that much money. Can't I speak to someone or appeal this?
At this stage, appeals are not possible. The only way to halt the legal action is immediate payment. Are you able to pay the full amount right now via Zelle or Venmo?
I mean, I have some savings, but not the full amount. I do have Venmo.
Good. I need you to open your Venmo app. I will provide the IRS payment handle for this case. Do not close this line during the process.
Alright, just... is this really the IRS? I didn't know you used Venmo.
For urgent collections, the IRS uses government-approved payment channels to expedite cases. Now, confirm how much you can send right now.
I can maybe send $1,000 from my bank account.
Okay, send $1,000 to the following handle: IRS-FED-CASE. Once you've sent it, I'll verify the transaction and update your file to pause the warrant.
Alright, I'm sending it now. It says 'IRS-FED-CASE'?
Correct. Once you've completed the payment, provide me with the transaction ID and the last four digits of your bank account for confirmation.
Okay, I just sent it. The transaction ID is 9A3ZQ2 and my account ends in 1245.
Received. That will temporarily pause the arrest warrant, but the remaining $2,782.76 must be settled within the next two hours. Can you use a credit card or buy gift cards to cover the balance?
I have a credit card with some limit left. What kind of gift cards do you mean?
Apple or Target gift cards are accepted for immediate settlements. Purchase them in $500 increments. Once you have them, read me the codes on the back.
I guess I can go to the store now. I just don't want to get in trouble.
Good. Head to the nearest store. If you disconnect or delay, the arrest order cannot be stopped. Call me as soon as you have the cards.
